# Objectives and text

Objectives, dialogs, counters, map labels and the text the player reads.

Topic `objectives-and-text`, declared by ops. Back to [the map](../README.md).

## Mechanisms

### PLAYED

- [dialog-button-ingame-dictionary](../../components/ops/knowledge/mechanisms/dialog-button-ingame-dictionary.md): Dialog button labels resolve only in the game's in-game interface dictionary (ops, verified 201602)
- [dialog-reask-loop](../../components/ops/knowledge/mechanisms/dialog-reask-loop.md): A multiple-choice dialog can be asked again in a loop if the choice is reset before each ask (ops, verified 201602)
- [objective-counters](../../components/ops/knowledge/mechanisms/objective-counters.md): Objective text shows live counters from a variable list (ops, verified 201602)

### PROBED

- [chinese-text-stock-glyphs](../../components/ops/knowledge/mechanisms/chinese-text-stock-glyphs.md): Simplified Chinese text must stay within the characters stock text already uses (ops, verified 210942)
- [objective-waits-until-resolved](../../components/ops/knowledge/mechanisms/objective-waits-until-resolved.md): An objective finishes only after it resolves and its chosen actions finish (ops, verified 201602)

### STOCK

- [dialog-text-takes-no-variables](../../components/ops/knowledge/mechanisms/dialog-text-takes-no-variables.md): Dialog text cannot show live numbers; counts go in an objective counter or a hint (ops, verified 201602)
- [objective-label-needs-position](../../components/ops/knowledge/mechanisms/objective-label-needs-position.md): An objective's map label needs a position, or it pins the map corner (ops, verified 201602)

## Lessons

Taught by the trials of these mechanisms.

- [crash-box-hides-the-error](../../components/core/knowledge/lessons/crash-box-hides-the-error.md) (core): A crash box hides the real error; read the dump before guessing
- [debrief-by-what-the-map-shows](../../components/core/knowledge/lessons/debrief-by-what-the-map-shows.md) (core): Design probe results to show on the map, and debrief with a few multiple-choice questions about what was seen
- [decide-zones-by-count](../../components/ops/knowledge/lessons/decide-zones-by-count.md) (ops): Decide zone rules by timed counts and force the owner; keep real captures for flavour
- [fix-loop-after-a-failed-launch](../../components/core/knowledge/lessons/fix-loop-after-a-failed-launch.md) (core): After a failed launch, find the root cause, gate it, fix, reinstall hash-checked, and update the play sheet
- [gates-model-the-game-lookup](../../components/core/knowledge/lessons/gates-model-the-game-lookup.md) (core): A gate checks the data where the game reads it, not just that it exists somewhere
- [one-stall-hides-the-rest](../../components/core/knowledge/lessons/one-stall-hides-the-rest.md) (core): Put each probe beat in its own parallel branch, so one stall cannot hide the rest
- [prove-each-gate-both-ways](../../components/core/knowledge/lessons/prove-each-gate-both-ways.md) (core): A gate is proven when it fails the bad build with the game's own words and passes every stock file
- [ui-flag-needs-its-anchor](../../components/ops/knowledge/lessons/ui-flag-needs-its-anchor.md) (ops): A UI flag needs its anchor
